policy: V23 prevents concurrent over-authorization of one current distribution capacity by adding a non-accounting reservation/commitment layer. Reservations reduce authorizable capacity before settlement without changing ReportingLedger/P&L/NAV, remain outstanding through settlement-to-accounting gaps, and are released only by exact terminal/accounting transitions.

additions.authority_note: Version-chained non-accounting commitment bound to one exact Plan digest, affected period, currency and DistributionAvailableCapacity v2 basis. ACTIVE/ATTEMPTED amounts remain fully outstanding; partial settlement releases failed remainder but settled amount remains outstanding until exact canonical owner-distribution accounting is proven.

Aggregate current authorization-capacity state for one reporting-currency domain. remaining_authorizable_capacity=max(0,current DistributionAvailableCapacity v2 - outstanding latest reservations). It is commitment/reference state only and cannot authorize a payment by itself; production requires durable transactional CAS on state version/digest.
